This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

The German Maus weighed 207 US tons — so heavy no bridge could hold it. It forded rivers underwater with a snorkel and power from a second tank. Top speed 13 mph. Hitler wanted 150. They built two hulls and one turret.
What other insane WWII tank should we cover next?
